'''2011 Yavin 4 Regionals Mike Battaglia DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Battaglia]] at [[2011 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' High Roller
* '''Username:''' Epyons-Anger
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
